result.reason: The operative clause reaches only the fallback 90-day conformance period for software/deliverables. It does not provide a professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, a distinct services warranty period, compliance with laws, or a no-malicious-code warranty. It promises only correction; without Section 19.4's text, it does not establish the required repair, replacement, or refund remedies. The additions of Order Form specifications and an acceptance-based trigger go beyond the stated position, while the margin comment inaccurately describes the playbook periods and cannot cure the operative omissions.
